gaps: topics/013.php says booster packs 1 to 4 are block 1, 5 to 8 block 2, "and so on", but the printed icons do not follow that past OP-12: OP-13 to OP-15 are block 4 and OP-16 and OP-17 are block 5 (official series pages; Limitless agrees for every meta card). This file uses the printed icons for every booster. rulings.md RL-37 applies the formula to OP15-096; that still gives 4, which matches.

No cited block for starter decks ST-08, ST-22, ST-23, ST-24, ST-25, ST-28, ST-33, ST-35 and ST-36: none of their printings is on a cached official series page or a Limitless page read so far. Their Standard legality is "unknown" until a source is read.
Promotion cards (P-xxx) have no product block: each promo carries its own printed block. Only promos with a verified override (P-088, P-093, block 3 on Limitless) have one; the rest are "unknown".
ST-13: one printing in the promotion series (569901) shows block 1 while 12 others show 2; the product block is taken as 2.
OP15-096 has no block on the official site; the booster formula gives 4 (rulings.md RL-37).
The OP07-115 + EB04-058 banned pair has no effective date on the pages read.
Whether the banned list also applies to Extra Regulation is not stated on restriction.html; this file applies it to both.
EB-05 (2026-10-30) and OP-18 (2026-11-20) are not in optcgapi yet; they enter through cards:update when upstream has them.
